question: What is the state of the art system mentioned?

answer.free_form_answer:
Two knowledge-based systems,
two traditional word expert supervised systems, six recent neural-based systems, and one BERT feature-based system.

title: GlossBERT: BERT for Word Sense Disambiguation with Gloss Knowledge
answer_short: fine-tunes the pre-trained BERT model to treat WSD as a sentence-pair classification task
answer_rationale: The state-of-the-art system mentioned in the documents is described as fine-tuning the pre-trained BERT model to treat Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) as a sentence-pair classification task. This approach is explicitly stated in both Text 1 and Text 2, and Text 3 confirms that this method significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art systems.
